description: Screen a person or business name against 12 U.S. government watchlists (OFAC SDN, BIS Entity/Denied/Unverified/MEU, State Dept Debarred/ISN, and more) via the Consolidated Screening List. Returns fuzzy-matched records. NOTE: name-based matching, NOT identity confirmation — verify any hit against the official source before acting.

includeAliases.description: Also match alternate names/AKAs. Default true.

lists.description: Restrict to source-list name substrings (e.g. ["SDN","Entity List"]). Omit for all lists.

name.description: Person or business name to screen

name: watchlist_screen
